concurrencyPolicies.coalesce_if_active: If a run is already active, keep just one follow-up run queued.
concurrencyPolicies.always_enqueue: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if the routine is already running.
concurrencyPolicies.skip_if_active: Drop new trigger occurrences while a run is still active.

catchUpPolicies.skip_missed: Ignore windows that were missed while the scheduler or routine was paused.
catchUpPolicies.enqueue_missed_with_cap: Catch up missed schedule windows in capped batches after recovery.

detail.draftWarning: Default agent required. This routine can stay as a draft and still run manually, but automation stays paused until you assign a default agent.

concurrencyPolicies.coalesce_if_active: Keep one follow-up run queued while an active run is still working.
concurrencyPolicies.always_enqueue: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if several runs stack up.
concurrencyPolicies.skip_if_active: Drop overlapping trigger occurrences while the routine is already active.

catchUpPolicies.skip_missed: Ignore schedule windows that were missed while the routine or scheduler was paused.
catchUpPolicies.enqueue_missed_with_cap: Catch up missed schedule windows in capped batches after recovery.

signingModes.bearer: Expect a shared bearer token in the Authorization header.
signingModes.hmac_sha256: Expect an HMAC SHA-256 signature over the request using the shared secret.
signingModes.github_hmac: Accept GitHub-style X-Hub-Signature-256 header (HMAC over raw body, no timestamp).
signingModes.none: No authentication — the webhook URL itself acts as a shared secret.
